result:
If I could change the world in one way, it would be to give every person a deeper, more reliable capacity to understand one another — not necessarily to agree, but to truly listen.

So much of the world’s suffering comes from miscommunication, fear, and the inability to see others as fully real. If empathy were easier and more widespread, many other problems — conflict, injustice, neglect — might become far more solvable.
